description: The W57 receipt-e-mail fixture: one cash payment of the full 20.00 invoice total, received 8 Aug 2025 14:30 UTC, driving the receipt endpoint end to end. Every receipt-HTML cell class is exercised with plain, escapable-character-free values — Receipt number R00000002 (uppercased last eight of the payment id), Date 8/8/2025 and Time 2:30:00 PM (the two locale-pinned interpolations), Invoice #00000008, patient Name/Email/Phone rows, payment method chip, Reference row, and both currency cells rendered as USD $20.00 through toFixed(2).
usage: Seed block first (patients, appointments, invoices, invoice_items, payments), then POST /api/send-receipt-email with requests[0]. The payment received_at (8 Aug 14:30 UTC) sits outside every invoices/payments export window, so this fixture can never contaminate a CSV comparison on a combined scratch database. No export request: this fixture drives the receipt e-mail only; legacy_inputs.receipts[0] is the byte reference for buildReceiptHtml / receiptEmailSubject.

contract.receipt_email: byte-identical to buildReceiptHtml(legacy_inputs.receipts[0]) and to receiptEmailSubject(legacy_inputs.receipts[0]) (W57): the subject Payment Receipt R00000002; the template's Receipt R00000002 header, Date 8/8/2025, Time 2:30:00 PM (TZ=UTC, the pinned legacyDate/legacyTime of api/lib/format.mjs — the same en-US characters the hosted Deno runtime produced), Invoice #00000008, patient Name Zara Specimen with Email and Phone rows, payment-method chip cash, Reference row RCP-0808, Invoice Total USD $20.00 and Amount Paid USD $20.00. No value carries an escapable character, so the S10 escapeHtml pass is the identity here and the ported email-receipt builder matches the shipped bytes exactly, CSS and whitespace included.
contract.seeding: the payment covers the invoice total, so recalc_invoice_payments flips d...0008 to paid and sets paid_amount 20.00 — legacy_inputs mirrors that post-trigger state (status paid, paid_amount 20), matching the PostgREST row the shipped function would have fetched after the payment was recorded. invoices.updated_at is deliberately absent from the embed: a trigger mutates it on every recalc and neither builder reads it.
